definition: Company-issued guidance is populated from primary earnings releases. Eulerpool is the configured source for a daily, attributed, current consensus and valuation-context snapshot; its fields remain unpopulated until the protected ingestion workflow completes successfully. Management outlook is not analyst consensus, and a current snapshot is not a substitute for fiscal-aligned revision or valuation history.
